business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Project-driven Engineering, Procurement and Execution (EPC) and turnkey electrical infrastructure company delivering end-to-end electrical and infrastructure projects across India, including specialized MEP works; incorporated in 2009 as a product/OEM-oriented electrical solutions provider and evolved into a full-scale project execution and infrastructure organization, reflected in its 2022 rebranding.
- Positioned to capitalize on India's structural infrastructure growth themes -- the National Infrastructure Pipeline, Smart Cities Mission and energy-efficiency programs -- across commercial, industrial, healthcare, educational and public-infrastructure end-markets.
- Operates across Electrical, Mechanical and MEP Services sectors spanning government/public infrastructure, smart-city works, hospitality and commercial real estate, residential townships and industrial/institutional infrastructure.
- Certified to ISO 9001:2015 (Quality), ISO 14001:2015 (Environmental) and ISO 45001:2018 (Occupational Health & Safety); deck cites a track record of 758 projects done and 143 clients satisfied over 25 years of experience.
